veranderings.rede: The dangling 'op' is colloquial; 'daarop' completes the phrase in standard written Afrikaans.
'hom' could point to the province or to its name; 'langsaan' removes the unclear pronoun.

veranderings.voor: kom Gauteng se staaf se bopunt by daardie getal
veranderings.na: kom die bopunt van Gauteng se staaf by daardie getal
veranderings.rede: Two stacked possessive 'se' forms are clumsy; one 'van' phrase reads more easily.

veranderings.voor: Party stawe staan hoog en ander
veranderings.na: Party stawe staan hoog, en ander
veranderings.rede: AWS comma: 'en' joins two clauses that each have their own subject and verb.

veranderings.voor: staan die laagste en daar woon
veranderings.na: staan die laagste, en daar woon
veranderings.rede: AWS comma: 'en' joins two clauses that each have their own subject and verb.

veranderings.voor: Elke bevolkingsdigtheid in die lys is bereken deur die provinsie se mense deur sy oppervlakte in vierkante kilometer te deel.
veranderings.na: Vir elke bevolkingsdigtheid in die lys is die getal mense in die provinsie gedeel deur sy oppervlakte in vierkante kilometer.
veranderings.rede: Removes the double 'deur ... deur' and says the number of people is divided, not the people themselves; the meaning is unchanged.

veranderings.voor: vergelyk getalle mense en die ander
veranderings.na: vergelyk getalle mense, en die ander
veranderings.rede: AWS comma: 'en' joins two clauses that each have their own subject and verb.

veranderings.voor: Gauteng is die kleinste provinsie in oppervlakte van al nege.
veranderings.na: Gauteng het die kleinste oppervlakte van al nege provinsies.
veranderings.rede: 'van al nege' stranded after 'in oppervlakte' is awkward; the reworded sentence is more natural and means the same.

veranderings.voor: Noord-Kaap is die grootste provinsie in oppervlakte en het die minste mense
veranderings.na: Noord-Kaap het die grootste oppervlakte en die minste mense
veranderings.rede: Matches the Gauteng sentence and is smoother; the meaning is unchanged.

veranderings.voor: vir die hele provinsie en die mense woon
veranderings.na: vir die hele provinsie, en die mense woon
veranderings.rede: AWS comma: 'en' joins two clauses that each have their own subject and verb.
'n vol stad' is vague and unidiomatic; 'n stad vol mense' says plainly what is full.
'naas' is formal for Grade 6; 'saam met' says the same thing more plainly.

vlae.teks: Die getal wat jy kry as jy 'n totaal gelyk verdeel.
vlae.rede: The definition does not say what the total is shared among (the number of items), so it reads as incomplete; fixing it would add content, so it is flagged rather than changed.
